Summary of the Kalasin Constituency 6 (List-MP) Election Result Announcement


This document, S.S. 6/1 (BCh), is the announcement by the Election Commission of Constituency 6, Kalasin Province, regarding the results of the counting of votes for List-MP candidates, following the election on February 8, B.E. 2569 (2026).


Election Statistics:
Number of Eligible Voters: 135,642 people.
Number of Voters who Appeared: 95,811 people.
Total Ballots Received by the Constituency: 136,930 ballots.
Total Ballots Used: 95,811 ballots.
Total Ballots Remaining: 41,119 ballots.
Total Ballots Used for Counting (Total of 3.1-3.3): 95,811 ballots.
Ballots from polling stations: 87,936 ballots.
Ballots cast before election day in the constituency: 25 ballots.
Ballots cast before election day outside the constituency and outside the Kingdom: 7,850 ballots.
Total Valid Votes: 89,550 ballots.
Invalid Ballots (Spoiled): 4,604 ballots.
Ballots where no party list was selected: 1,657 ballots.
Top Vote-Receiving Parties (List-MP):


The top four vote-receiving parties, listed by the number of votes they received, were:
Pheu Thai (เพื่อไทย): 40,190 votes.
Prachachon (ประชาชน): 20,741 votes.
Bhumjaithai (ภูมิใจไทย): 12,189 votes.
Mai (ใหม่): 2,546 votes.
The total votes received by all political parties was 89,550 votes. The announcement was made on February 8, B.E. 2569 (2026). The announcement was signed by the Chairperson (Ms. Om-aree Yewasri) and two committee members (Pol. Col. Ekachai Saensadee and Mr. Nopparat Saisombat) of the Constituency Election Commission.
